dialogue.content: (本日は宜しくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for coming today. We'll start when it's time.)

dialogue.content: （宜しくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは初めに年齢、性別、相談したい内容を教えてください
dialogue.English: Good evening. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: こんばんは、14歳です。なんとなく、友達と上手くいってないです。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm 14. I'm kind of not getting along with my friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれはもやもやしてしまいますね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very unsettling...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 14歳だと中学２年生ですか？
dialogue.English: At 14, are you in your second year of junior high?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。男の子か女の子かは聞いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. May I ask if you're a boy or a girl?

dialogue.content: 女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a girl.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。なんとなく、お友達とうまくいっていないと感じているんですね具体的にどういう感じなのかお話できますか
dialogue.English: Thank you for letting me know. It sounds like you feel things aren’t going well with your friends. Could you share a bit more about what that’s been like?

dialogue.content: 学校の授業でグループに分けれるのですが、いつものグループに行こうと思ったんだけど、なんとなく入れなくて、、そこから、話せてないです
dialogue.English: In class at school, we get split into groups, and I was going to join my usual group, but for some reason I felt like I couldn't... and since then, we haven't spoken.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかなんとなく入りずらい雰囲気になってしまっていたんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So there was an atmosphere that made it feel difficult to join them, is that right?

dialogue.content: 雰囲気というか、自分がいくことができなかったみたい、、よく分からないです
dialogue.English: It wasn't so much the atmosphere... it was more like I couldn't bring myself to go... I don't really know why.

dialogue.content: わからないけどそう感じたんですね例えば目が合わなかったとか、返事がそっけなかったとか、、何かいつもと違うことを感じたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You weren't sure, but that's how it felt. For example, did they avoid eye contact, or were their replies curt? Did you notice anything different from usual?

dialogue.content: 入れなかったから、そのまま一人で過ごしました。
dialogue.English: Since I couldn't join them, I just spent the time by myself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね寂しい気持ちになっちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must have made you feel lonely.

dialogue.content: はい、寂しかったです
dialogue.English: Yes, I was lonely.

dialogue.content: うんうん、色々考えてしまったかと思います。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. I imagine you had a lot on your mind.

dialogue.content: それから、うまくいってません。話とかしないので距離あいちゃって、、
dialogue.English: Since then, things haven't been going well. We don't talk, so we've grown distant...

dialogue.content: ちなみに何人くらいのグループですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, about how many people are in the group?

dialogue.content: ５人です
dialogue.English: Five.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかそのグループに入りにくくなってしまったのはどれくらい前のことですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How long ago did it become difficult to join that group?

dialogue.content: 2ヶ月くらい前かな
dialogue.English: About two months ago, I think.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね辛かったですね長く感じたことと思います
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been tough. I'm sure it felt like a very long time.

dialogue.content: 友達ではなかったのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe we weren't really friends.

dialogue.content: そう思うのはどうしてなのか話せますか？話しやすいところからでいいですよ
dialogue.English: Could you tell me why you think that? You can start wherever feels easiest.

dialogue.content: 誰も私がいかなかった時に呼びにいてくれなかったから
dialogue.English: Because when I didn't go over to them, no one came to get me.

dialogue.content: 教室とかかな？
dialogue.English: Was this in the classroom or something?

dialogue.content: さっきのグループで集まる時に、私がいかなかったのに、誰も呼びに来てくれなかったから。
dialogue.English: When we were gathering in that group earlier, I didn't go, but no one came to get me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、なるほど、、友達なら呼びに来てほしかったんですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see. So you're saying if they were truly your friends, you would have wanted them to come and get you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あれから、ずっと気まずくて、ずっと1人だし、学校もつまんない
dialogue.English: Ever since then, it's been awkward. I've been alone all the time, and school is boring.

dialogue.content: そうですよね学校がつまんなくなってしまいますよねそれまでは楽しかった？
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It would make school feel boring, wouldn't it? Was it fun before that?

dialogue.content: グループにいたから、それなりには
dialogue.English: Since I was in the group, it was okay, I guess.

dialogue.content: 誰かにこのことを話したりはしましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: 話してません。
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: ひとりで抱えてきたんですね頑張って学校にきていたんですね
dialogue.English: So you've been carrying this all by yourself. You've been trying so hard just to come to school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きっかけはあまり思い当たらないのですよね
dialogue.English: And you can't really think of a specific trigger, right?

dialogue.content: その時からです
dialogue.English: It started from that time.

dialogue.content: 1人だし、みんな私のことは必要ないと思う
dialogue.English: I'm alone, and I feel like nobody needs me.

dialogue.content: そう感じているんですね、、あなたはどうでしょうみんなとどうなりたいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling... As for you, how would you like things to be with everyone?

dialogue.content: 1人じゃなければいいかな。話せるようになりたいけど、
dialogue.English: I guess it would be nice not to be alone. I want to be able to talk to them, but...

dialogue.content: そう思っているんですねでは一緒に考えましょう
dialogue.English: So that's what you're hoping for. Then let's think about it together.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 呼びにきてくれなかったというのはなんでなのかはわかりますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea why they didn't come to get you?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねいつもならきてくれた？
dialogue.English: I see. Would they normally have come for you?

dialogue.content: 自分からいくから、
dialogue.English: I usually go myself, so...

dialogue.content: でも、その時は入るところがなかったから
dialogue.English: But that time, there was no room for me to join.

dialogue.content: 入りにくかったという事かな？
dialogue.English: So you mean it was hard to join in?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほどどんな感じがしましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did that feel?

dialogue.content: 呼びに来て欲しかった
dialogue.English: I wanted them to come and get me.

dialogue.content: 入りにくかったから呼びにくるのを待っていた、でも来なかった。その時どんな風に思ったんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Because it was hard to join, you waited for them to come get you, but they didn't. What went through your mind at that moment?

dialogue.content: 寂しかったです
dialogue.English: I felt lonely.

dialogue.content: わたしがいなくてもいいんだなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought they were fine without me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そう感じたのですねみんなと友達だと思っていたのに裏切られたような気持ちかな、、？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I understand that's how you felt. Since you thought you were all friends, did it perhaps feel like a betrayal?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: 行きにくなったから、そこからそうなった
dialogue.English: It became difficult to approach them, and things have been this way since then.

dialogue.content: 苦しい思いをしていると思いますまた話しかけてみるというのはどう思いますか？
dialogue.English: I know this must be painful for you. What do you think about trying to talk to them again?

dialogue.content: うーん今更って感じ、、
dialogue.English: Hmm... it feels too late now.

dialogue.content: もう、これが当たり前みたいな感じになってる。
dialogue.English: It's already become the new normal.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね時間が経ちすぎた感じがあるんですね他に仲良くなれそうなお友達はいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So it feels like too much time has passed. Are there any other friends you think you could get along with?

dialogue.content: みんなグループできてるし、難しい
dialogue.English: Everyone's already in their own groups, so it's difficult.

dialogue.content: グループにわかれてしまっていると、新しく入っていくのはなかなか勇気がいりますよね
dialogue.English: When everyone is already split into groups, it takes a lot of courage to try and join a new one, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 新しく入ることはできないと思う。
dialogue.English: I don't think I can join a new one.

dialogue.content: なんで？ってみんな思うから
dialogue.English: Because everyone would be like, "Why?"

dialogue.content: 私のことなんて、みんな好きじゃないと思う
dialogue.English: I don't think anyone likes me.

dialogue.content: そう感じているのはどうしてかな？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: そう思うから
dialogue.English: Just because that's what I think.

dialogue.content: そう思っているのはとても辛いことですよね以前からそんなことを感じていたんですか？
dialogue.English: It must be very painful to think that. Have you felt this way for a while?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれない
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: 今日はお時間がきてしまいました。また話したくなったら一緒にどうしていこうかお話しませんか。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up for today. If you'd like to talk again, we can discuss what to do from here.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとう終了のメッセージが流れます。またきてくださいね
dialogue.English: Thank you. A closing message will now play. Please come again.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。お手数ですがフィードバックお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. If you don't mind, please provide some feedback.)
